meta.description: 4cash — a demo casino built on microservices: bets flow through Kafka, payouts and notifications through RabbitMQ, and the UI updates live over SSE.

footer.about: A demo project: NestJS microservices with Kafka, RabbitMQ and PostgreSQL, UI on Next.js. Play chips only, no real money.
footer.disclaimer: Not gambling: chips are never bought or cashed out for real.

author.title: Looking for a team that needs good engineers

pick.apiDown: The API is unavailable. Start the backend: docker compose up -d

create.title: New player
create.description: The player is created in wallet-service; the starting deposit is a separate transaction.

gate.title: Choose who you play as
gate.text: There's no sign-in — it's a demo. Take a demo player or create your own.

blocked.title: This player was blocked by anti-fraud
blocked.text: risk-service spotted suspicious activity; wallet-service blocked the account. New bets will be rejected.

hero.title: A casino where every bet is <accent>+MONEY</accent>
hero.text: Roulette and crash. Get a taste of victory playing our games.

pick.title: Who are we playing as?
pick.text: Demo players were seeded for manual play: one has 10 thousand chips, another 250 thousand, the third almost nothing.

roulette.title: Roulette
roulette.text: European, 37 pockets, PvE. Pick a spot, a chip amount and spin the wheel.

crash.title: Crash
crash.text: One shared round: the multiplier climbs until it crashes. Cash out before it does.

feed.title: Live bets
feed.subtitle: All players
feed.empty: Quiet so far. Place a bet or run pnpm simulate.

roulette.title: Roulette
roulette.subtitle: Pick a spot on the table and a chip. roulette-service picks the number; the wheel only shows the result.
roulette.waiting: Bet is in play, waiting for the result…
roulette.hint: Place a bet to spin the wheel
roulette.selectBet: Pick a spot on the table

crash.title: Crash
crash.subtitle: One round for everyone. Bet while betting is open and cash out before the chart crashes.
crash.autoHint: The server cashes out for you at this multiplier (1.01–100)
crash.players: {count, plural, one {# player} other {# players}} in the round

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.subtitle: The balance updates from wallet.transactions events. Withdrawals go through the payouts queue with retries, a DLQ and a refund if the provider declines.

deposit.label: Deposit amount
deposit.hint: The balance is topped up as soon as you click.

withdraw.label: Withdrawal amount
withdraw.hint: Chips are debited right away. The payment provider sometimes fails — then retries or a refund kick in.

leaderboard.title: Leaders
leaderboard.subtitle: leaderboard-service builds this table from Kafka events only, and it's fetched via Kafka request-reply.
leaderboard.unavailable: leaderboard-service didn't respond. It may have just started — refresh in a few seconds.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: 4cash is a learning playground that shows how the mini-games work. Chips have no financial backing; the project is non-commercial.

kafka.title: Kafka — the event log
kafka.a: Bets, their results and money movements are events read by several independent services.
kafka.b: The message key is playerId: one player's events are processed strictly in order.
kafka.c: The leaderboard can be rebuilt from scratch by re-reading history (replay).

rabbit.title: RabbitMQ — tasks and commands
rabbit.a: A payout must run on exactly one worker, with acknowledgement, retries and a dead-letter queue.
rabbit.b: Notifications are routed to channels by a topic exchange: push, email, admin.
rabbit.c: Balance lookups and crash cash-outs are synchronous RPC answered in milliseconds.

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.flowText: The HTTP request returns immediately (202); after that the bet travels through Kafka topics. The UI learns the result over SSE.

flow.live: Gateway streams the event to the browser

services.gateway: HTTP API, SSE stream to the browser, RPC to other services
services.wallet: Balances, debits and payouts; transactional outbox
services.roulette: Spins the wheel, idempotent on redelivery
services.crash: Round game loop; recovers after a crash
services.risk: Anti-fraud over event-time windows, blocks bots
services.payments: Payouts: manual ack, TTL retry, DLQ
services.notifications: Push, email and alerts through a topic exchange

notify.withdrawal_failed: Withdrawal of {amount} declined ({reason}); chips returned to your balance
